boundaries: Retained response hashes do not imply public raw-archive delivery or independent verification of all source assertions. Original HTML and tool-extracted text are distinguished.
No embedded audiovisual, raw AIS, paid satellite, private negotiating, procurement, settlement or shareholder-transaction records were inspected.
Upcoming meetings, announced delegations, fundraising plans and reported support needs remain distinct from attendance, agreement, pledges, money transfer and delivery.

AP and its identified republication are one reporting family. Named provider displays are not an individual destination pairing attributed retroactively to AP. Relative position ages and ETA timezones remain qualified.
Corporate company-level results, balance-sheet assets, sale proceeds and dated ownership are non-additive observations, not personal receipts or a policy exchange.
Historical claims, correction history, unresolved records, scores and financial-flow totals are preserved.
